title: 第六章 玛奇玛，你给我当狗吧
slug: 电锯人开局契约斩杀线恶魔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

十分钟后。

一辆黑色的高级轿车行驶在东京夜晚的街道上。

车内的气氛，却压抑得让人几乎无法呼吸。

早川秋坐在驾驶位上，双手紧握着方向盘，目光不时通过后视镜瞥向后座。被迫坐上副驾驶位置的东山小红则像一只鹌鹑一样缩成一团，连大气都不敢喘。

而在后座，言良和玛奇玛并排而坐。

封闭的车厢内，言良身上浓烈的血腥味，与玛奇玛身上那种迷人的香水味分出了明晰的界限。

“言良君的资料，在我们的系统里似乎是一片空白呢。”玛奇玛微微侧头，红色的发丝随着动作轻轻晃动，“你不是东京本地人？那么，你来这里是有什么目的吗？”

“我对这里没有任何兴趣，只是一觉醒来就被绑到了这个鬼地方。”言良靠在真皮座椅上，姿态放松，随口敷衍道，“为了自保，稍微用了一点过激的手段。公安应该不会连正当防卫都要抓吧？”

“当然不会。”玛奇玛轻笑着，身体却在不经意间向言良的方向倾斜了几分。

在这个狭窄的空间里，两人的距离被迅速拉近。玛奇玛那双包裹在极薄黑色丝袜中的双腿，随着车辆的轻微颠簸，有意无意地贴紧了言良的裤腿。隔着衣料，言良甚至能感受到那温热的体温。

“其实，我个人非常欣赏像言良君这样，充满未知与力量的人呢。”

车窗外路灯的微光飞速掠过玛奇玛的侧脸，她那双包裹在黑丝下的长腿又不动声色地向前压了一分，两人的肢体在狭小的空间里紧贴。

“冷静，果断，以及你刚才站在血泊里的姿态，那种连生与死都不放在眼里的傲慢……”她将身体转过，领口那抹令人遐想的深邃弧度在言良的余光中若隐若现，“但是这个世界是很残酷的，言良君拥有力量，却没有身份，也没有可以安眠的床铺，就像流浪的小狗一样。”

“孤身一人可是很辛苦的……”

玛奇玛的声音变得更加低柔，带着一种足以让所以男人沦陷的魅惑。她凑近言良的耳边，温热的气息吹拂到了言良的脖颈。

“不如，加入公安吧。不……”

“确切地说，让我来饲养你吧。”

她顿了顿，那双金色的眼眸中闪烁着迷离的光泽。

“如果你愿意做我的狗，我可以给你想要的一切。合法的身份、舒适的住所、金钱……”玛奇玛的目光慢慢下移，黑丝包裹的大腿又向言良贴紧了一分，“只要你听话，什么奖励都可以哦。”

前排的早川秋听到这话，眼角狠狠一抽。而东山小红已经快把头埋进膝盖里了，恨不得自己当场聋掉。

面对这致命的诱惑，言良却连呼吸都没有乱掉半分。

他转过头，那只纯白色的恶魔之眼盯着近在咫尺的玛奇玛。随后，在车内三人难以置信的目光中，言良不仅没有退缩，反而直接伸出了那只还沾着暗红色血迹的手。

“啪。”

言良的手，强硬地按在了玛奇玛那裹着黑丝的大腿上。

Ten minutes later.

A black limousine drove down the streets of Tokyo at night.

The atmosphere inside the car was so oppressive that it was almost impossible to breathe.

Hayakawa Qiu sat in the driver's seat, holding the steering wheel with both hands, and glanced at the rear seat through the rearview mirror from time to time.Dongshan Xiaohong, who was forced to sit in the passenger seat, huddled up like a quail, not even daring to breathe.

In the back seat, Yanliang and Makima sat side by side.

In the closed carriage, there was a clear distinction between the strong smell of blood on Yan Liang's body and the charming scent of perfume on Makima's body.

"Yan Liangjun's information seems to be completely blank in our system." Makima tilted her head slightly, her red hair swaying slightly with the movement, "You are not a native of Tokyo? So, what is your purpose here?"

"I have no interest in this place. I just woke up and was tied to this hellish place." Yan Liang leaned on the leather seat, relaxed his posture, and said casually, "In order to protect myself, I used a little drastic means. The police shouldn't even arrest me for self-defense, right?"

"Of course not." Makima chuckled, but her body inadvertently tilted a little towards Yan Liang.

In this narrow space, the distance between the two people was quickly shortened.Machima's legs, wrapped in extremely thin black stockings, clung to Yanliang's trouser legs intentionally or unintentionally as the vehicle bumped slightly.Yan Liang could even feel the warm body temperature through the clothes.

"Actually, I personally admire people like Yan Liangjun who are full of unknowns and power."

The dim light from the streetlight outside the car window quickly passed over Makima's profile. Her long legs wrapped in black stockings quietly pressed forward, and their limbs were close to each other in the small space.

"Calmness, decisiveness, and the posture you just stood in a pool of blood, that arrogance that didn't even care about life and death..." She turned her body, and the dreamy and deep arc of her collar loomed in Yan Liang's peripheral vision, "But this world is very cruel. Yan Liangjun has power, but no identity, and no bed to sleep on, just like a stray puppy."

"It's hard to be alone..."

Machima's voice became softer, with a charm that could make any man fall for her.She leaned close to Yan Liang's ear, and her warm breath blew on Yan Liang's neck.

"Why don't you join the police? No..."

"To be precise, let me raise you."

She paused, her golden eyes flashing with a blur of luster.

"If you are willing to be my dog, I can give you everything you want. Legal status, comfortable residence, money..." Makima's eyes slowly moved down, and her thigh wrapped in black stockings pressed closer to Yan Liang, "As long as you are obedient, any reward will be fine."

Hayakawa Akira in the front row twitched hard when he heard this.And Dongshan Xiaohong had almost buried her head in her knees, wishing she could become deaf on the spot.

Faced with this fatal temptation, Yan Liang didn't even lose his breath.

He turned his head, and his pure white devil's eye stared at Makima who was very close at hand.Later, under the disbelieving looks of the three people in the car, Yan Liang not only did not flinch, but directly stretched out his hand that was still stained with dark red blood.

"Crack."

Yanliang's hand pressed hard on Machima's thigh covered in black stockings.
